bus_LDO.input_cap: C10 retained 10u/16V selection, moved close to U3
bus_LDO.output_cap: C11 retained 22u/10V ceramic selection, moved close to U3
notes: OE is armed once after power-good; it is not clocked at the bus clock. ICCD is not applied to every data edge.
No PMOD/GPIO external 3.3V supply permitted. Internal FPGA/DDR3 rails are generated on the user-supplied Core.
50mA is a budget, not a declaration of full-temperature capability. Initial PoC at ordinary room ambient, temperature and startup to be measured.
Conservative off-time ripple bound (Vout_max+0.55V)/(Lmin*fmin), taking off-time fraction <=1; actual 12V buck ripple is smaller.
400kHz minimum frequency and 12uH minimum inductance; the 0.55V catch-diode allowance is an analytical assumption.
Short-circuit peaks, startup overshoot, thermal rise, core-bitstream peaks and full board continuous load capability require measurement.
The original compensated TPS5430/C7 220uF POSCAP topology is retained; no all-MLCC output substitution.

bringup.input: regulated 12V, centre-positive, 3A-class source with current limiting
bringup.minimum_test: electronic-load startup, ripple, load step and thermal checks before fitting Core; then low-speed parallel CRC/DDR3 bringup
bringup.firmware: Linux physical PARLIO/DMA and GPU board profile remain unverified; use separate appropriate bitstreams
